title: Potential Chemoprevention of Paeoniflorin in Colitis-Associated Colorectal Cancer by Network Pharmacology, Molecular Docking, and In Vivo Experiment.
authors: Si, Xiao-Li; Wang, Yan; Song, Bo-Ni; Zhang, Yan; Yang, Qing-Xia; Li, Zhi; Luo, Yan-Ping; Duan, Yong-Qiang; Ma, Xing-Ming; Zhang, Yan-Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学、分子对接和体内实验研究芍药苷对结肠炎相关结直肠癌的化学预防作用，虽含分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白靶点而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Chronic inflammation plays a positive role in the development and progression of colitis-associated colorectal cancer (CAC). Medicinal plants and their extracts with anti-inflammatory and immunoregulatory properties may be an effective treatment and prevention strategy for CAC. This research aimed to explore the potential chemoprevention of paeoniflorin (PF) for CAC by network pharmacology, molecular docking technology, and in vivo experiments. The results showed that interleukin-6 (IL-6) is a key target of PF against CAC. In the CAC mouse model, PF increased the survival rate of mice and decreased the number and size of colon tumors. Moreover, reduced histological score of colitis and expression of Ki-67 and PCNA were observed in PF-treated mice. In addition, the chemoprevention mechanisms of PF in CAC may be associated with suppression of the IL-6/STAT3 signaling pathway and the IL-17 level. This research provides experimental evidence of potential chemoprevention strategies for CAC treatment.
abstract_zh: 慢性炎症在结肠炎相关结直肠癌（CAC）的发生和发展中起着积极作用。具有抗炎和免疫调节特性的药用植物及其提取物可能成为CAC的有效治疗和预防策略。本研究旨在通过网络药理学、分子对接技术和体内实验，探讨芍药苷（PF）对CAC的潜在化学预防作用。结果表明，白细胞介素-6（IL-6）是PF对抗CAC的关键靶点。在CAC小鼠模型中，PF提高了小鼠的存活率，并减少了结肠肿瘤的数量和大小。此外，在PF处理的小鼠中观察到结肠炎的组织学评分降低，以及Ki-67和PCNA表达减少。另外，PF对CAC的化学预防机制可能与其抑制IL-6/STAT3信号通路和IL-17水平有关。本研究为CAC治疗的潜在化学预防策略提供了实验证据。
